findings.source_quote: οἱ δ’ ὑπὸ νόθου φύσεως τῷ καθαρῷ τῆς τροφῆς οὐκ ἀρεσκόμενοι, μόνης τῆς τῶν αἱμάτων γεύσεως ἐγλίχοντα.
findings.english_quote: they craved only the taste of blood.
findings.issue: The completed finite predicate depends on changing the supplied ἐγλίχοντα to conjectural ἐγλίχοντο. Independently, ἐγλίχοντα is not the regular third-person plural imperfect middle of γλίχομαι, and interpreting its ending as participial does not establish agreement with nominative plural οἱ ... ἀρεσκόμενοι. The recognizable stem and dependent genitive support a craving-related sense, but no defensible grammatical construction supporting this complete English assertion from the unchanged reading has been established. The notes honestly disclose the problem; that disclosure does not authorize the unsupported completion. The remaining block concerns the unresolved predicate, not ordinary lexical alternatives or uncertainty about the already image-checked print.
findings.suggested_revision: Keep ἐγλίχοντα identified as the supplied reading and ἐγλίχοντο explicitly identified as a proposed correction. Establish an evidenced historical grammatical or lexical construal supporting a complete rendering of the printed form, or obtain independent textual evidence supporting an explicitly documented source correction. Do not certify the present finite assertion merely because the correction is contextually plausible. Any resulting replacement must undergo fresh review.
